cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Page background, nav surface — warm off-white that reads as paper rather than screen

stone-surface.$description: Stone Surface — Card surfaces, secondary panels, inset border tone — one shade darker than canvas to create depth without shadow

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Headings, primary action fill, dark card surfaces — near-black that stays slightly warm

heading-charcoal.$description: Heading Charcoal — Primary text, nav text, decorative strokes — softened black for readable body

body-brown.$description: Body Brown — Body copy, secondary text — warm desaturated brown rather than cool gray

muted-gray.$description: Muted Gray — Helper text, inactive nav, tertiary labels

stone-border.$description: Stone Border — Hairline decorative borders on illustrations and shapes

link-blue.$description: Link Blue — Inline links, feature list text — vivid blue that reads as actionable without being a button

sky-blue.$description: Sky Blue — Illustration fill, decorative mascot accents — sky-bright for storybook characters

alt-blue.$description: Alt Blue — Secondary illustration fill, icon accents — slightly deeper blue for variation

grass-green.$description: Grass Green — Green text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

mint.$description: Mint — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

ember-orange.$description: Ember Orange — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

sun-yellow.$description: Sun Yellow — Illustration fill, decorative shapes, mascot coloring

gold.$description: Gold — Yellow text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.

honey.$description: Honey — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content

coral-pink.$description: Coral Pink — Purchase badge fill, decorative illustration accent

plum-violet.$description: Plum Violet — Violet wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

family.$description: Display and hero headings — the custom Family typeface at weight 500, letter-spacing tightening to -0.031em at 68px creates a slightly playful, slightly condensed character that defines the brand

inter.$description: Button labels and emphasized UI text — semi-bold for interactive elements that need to register as tappable
